# Current Body Observation: Feet

*You pause to examine your feet, taking note of their current state.*

Your feet are present, numbering two in total. They maintain their humanlike form, with the familiar architecture of five toes per foot. The shoe size remains consistent at US women's 6, with a medium width that hasn't changed.

The high arches are still prominent beneath your feet, creating that characteristic curve when weight isn't placed upon them. Your soles are smooth and humanlike in texture, showing no unusual markings or alterations.

Your toenails remain natural human nails, unadorned and maintaining their typical appearance. The skin covering your feet is light in color and smooth in texture, presenting no visible abnormalities.

The red heels you're wearing currently cover your feet completely. Through the material of the shoes, you can feel the familiar pressure and fit they provide on your high-arched feet.

No particular symptoms or discomfort are present in your feet at this moment beyond what might be expected from wearing heels.
